title: fix(catgpt): update selfie reference URL and switch to nanobanana-2-lite
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15035

fixes the expired selfie reference URL for catgpt caricature generation and upgrades the preferred image model to nanobanana-2-lite
\- replace expired 30-day R2 selfie reference URL with durable raw GitHub asset
\- set `nanobanana-2-lite` as preferred model with tiered fallback to `nanobanana` and `gptimage`
\- add `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` to authorisation scopes in `getAuthorizeUrl`
\- update test suite to cover `nanobanana-2-lite` catalog spellings and fallback tiers
\- `README.md` now reflects current model, gateway architecture, and auth flow

gist.headline: The selfie garden regrows
gist.blurb: CatGPT’s caricature reference no longer wilts after 30 days, and its image brain has moved to nanobanana-2-lite. A small cat portrait pipeline, now with considerably fewer expired leaves.
gist.summary: CatGPT now uses a durable GitHub-hosted selfie reference, prefers nanobanana-2-lite for caricatures with nanobanana and gptimage fallback tiers, and authorizes google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image in its auth flow.
gist.impact: People generating CatGPT caricatures get a working reference image and the newer nanobanana-2-lite model by default, while the app can continue through its defined fallback models when needed.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy CatGPT portrait garden: a durable framed cat selfie hangs beside a retro image-generation terminal, while Polli helps refresh a blooming caricature print. The terminal should show a gentle three-step model path from nanobanana-2-lite to nanobanana to gptimage, represented as sprouting code-plants rather than a sterile diagram.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden hackerspace where Polli, the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, black antennae and oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wears a tiny painter’s beret while hanging a framed cat selfie beside a retro CRT terminal growing three labeled code-plants: “nanobanana-2-lite”, “nanobanana”, and “gptimage”; a cheerful pixel cat caricature print blooms nearby among flowers and vines. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
